notes: Act objectives and report card (GDD 6). Read by sim/objectives.gd.

quit_job_streak_days.note: GDD 6: mining revenue covers living costs for 90 straight days.

quit_job_window_days.note: Each day compares trailing 30-day mining revenue (BTC mined times that day's close) with 30 days of living costs, so solo luck does not break the streak on a quiet day.

crash_2011_window.note: Act 1 bonus: survive the 2011 crash without selling (peak close to the post-crash low, per historical.json).

act2_hashrate_target_ths.note: Act 2 primary objective (GDD 6: hit a hashrate target), met when the running hashrate reaches it on any day of the act. Sized for a 10 kW garage: about five Gen 2b units or two Gen 3 units.

grades.note: Report card grade at act end.
